name: a2a-agui-starter
description: Minimal starter template for building multi-agent applications with A2A Protocol and AG-UI

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "UI,Orch,Research,Analysis" --prefix-colors "cyan,gray,green,blue" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:orchestrator" "npm run dev:research" "npm run dev:analysis"

//: The @a2a-js/sdk upper bound is load-bearing. @a2a-js/sdk 1.x implements A2A protocol v1.0, a wire change rather than a module move. This starter pins @ag-ui/a2a-middleware 0.0.2, which itself depends on @a2a-js/sdk ^0.2.2 and speaks the pre-1.0 format, and the Python agents are held on the pre-1.0 line by the matching upper bound in agents/requirements.txt. Declaring the middleware's own range here keeps one deduped 0.2.x client instead of a second, newer copy hoisted alongside it. Moving this starter to protocol v1.0 needs a @ag-ui/a2a-middleware release first, then the JavaScript and Python pins together -- not one at a time.
